_notes: Sensirion STCC4 miniature CO2 sensor (paired with SHT41 for RH/T compensation). I2C addr 0x64. Detection is empty (unique address) - product-ID (get_product_id 0x365B -> 0x0901018A) cannot be used because the firmware detection path issues a single write+read transaction with no inter-command delay and the STCC4 NACKs a read issued immediately after a command. Init: start_continuous_measurement (0x218B). Poll: read_measurement (0xEC05) write then 1ms delay then read 12 bytes = 4 words CO2/temp/humidity/status, each 2 data bytes + CRC byte; CRC at offsets 2,5,8,11 skipped via 'at'. CO2 raw = ppm directly; temperature = -45 + 175*s/65535; humidity = -6 + 125*s/65535 (same as SHT4x). Verified working: stable continuous readings ~390ppm / ~26C / ~62%RH. IMPORTANT: because 0x64 is inside the RSAO ident-probe range (0x10..0x6f), the RSAO delegated-identification hook must NOT probe this address - its framed 0x99 vendor command is interpreted by the STCC4 as commands and stops the sensor measuring (product-ID stays readable but read_measurement/measurement-start commands then NACK). This is handled in RaftI2C DeviceIdentMgr::identifyDevice, which now only runs the delegated ident hook for addresses that have no standard device-type record; the STCC4 has one so it is never probed.
